description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for the change in site layout and keeping of the right of access to Britannic House of 00676/55/P10 approved 21/07/2021 for a part three storey part single storey rear extension and internal alterations to create twenty two bedrooms with associated bin storage, bicycle parking and alterations to external facade following planning permission
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission reference 00676/55/P10 dated 21 July 2021.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Heritage Statement dated 14/01/2021; Design and Access Statement; Transport Statement dated September 2020. Received: 01 June 2021. 3300- 01/FP Rev G; 3300-02/FP Rev G; 3300-03/FP Rev G; 3300-04/FP Rev G; 3300-05/FP Rev G; 3300-06/FP Rev H; 3300-07/FP Rev G; 3300-08/FP Rev G; 3300-09/FP Rev G; 3300-10/FP Rev G; 3300-11/FP Rev G; 3300-12/FP Rev H. Received: 14/07/2021. 3300-15/SR Rev H; 3300-17/FP Rev A; 3300-18/FP Rev A. Received: 10/11/2021. 2698-001. Received: 15/11/2021. 2698-001 Rev A. Received: 25/11/2021 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until full samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The submission shall include details for windows, doors, bricks and mortar details (including brick pattern), roof tiles, cladding, rain water goods, and all other materials to be used.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open
inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first use of the hereby approved extensions a Delivery and Servicing Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning authority detailing how deliveries and servicing will be managed for both uses on site including the use of the approved service bay to the south east of the site. Deliveries and servicing shall be thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details for the duration of the development.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first use of the hereby approved extensions the cycle parking shown on the approved plans shall be provided and thereafter retained without obstruction for the duration of the development.

Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved extensions evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
"	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
"	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
"	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved extensions evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the hotel use would achieve an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.

Condition : 9 - Prior to the first use of the parking area to the east of the site hereby approved a Parking Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing detailing how parking shall be managed on site to prevent parking outside of the marked bays. Parking shall thereafter only be permitted in accordance with the approved details for the duration of the development.

Condition : 10 - Prior to the first use of the hereby approved extensions the vehicular access onto Lampton Road shall be permanently closed and reinstated to footway in consultation with Hounslow Highways.
